about: Pins of the CI toolchain (.github/workflows/ci.yml, read by release/ci/toolchain.py; the scheduled .github/workflows/pins.yml checks that every URL here still serves its bytes). The build inputs themselves stay pinned in release/inputs.lock.json; this file pins the environment the CI job builds them in, so that the job reproduces the reference outputs of inputs.lock.json byte for byte. Every package below is at the version of inputs.lock.json toolchain.packages, which the job checks after installing (gcc's runtime libraries libgcc, libstdc++, libasan, libtsan and libubsan at gcc's version: the layer and its sanitizer unit tests link them). release/toolchain.py unpacks these same files into a folder of its own, so that a release build outside CI uses them too, without installing anything.

image.name: archlinux:base-20260830.0.582275
image.about: Official Arch Linux container image (Docker Hub library/archlinux, manifest list digest), the weekly image before the snapshot below. It only bootstraps pacman: the first workflow step points pacman at the snapshot and runs pacman -Syyuu, so every installed package comes from the snapshot whatever the image held. The workflows name this image literally (a container image cannot be read from a file); toolchain.py check-workflows checks that they name exactly this one.

snapshot.about: Arch Linux Archive daily repository snapshot. Every package of inputs.lock.json toolchain.packages has the locked version in the snapshots of 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-04 (checked 2026-10-18 from their core.db and extra.db): wine 11.16-2 arrived on 2026-08-31 and 11.17-1 replaced it on 2026-09-05; clang 23 followed before 2026-10-01. The machine that built the reference outputs on 2026-10-15 was last fully upgraded on 2026-09-04 before 09:00 UTC; this is the last snapshot before that upgrade, and its package files for the pins below are the same as in the 2026-09-01 snapshot.

linux-api-headers.about: The layer includes 24 kernel headers (asm-generic/errno.h, linux/prctl.h, ...). The reference machine has linux-api-headers 1:6.18-1 from another distribution's repository, and Arch's 6.18-1 holds the same 1028 files byte for byte (compared 2026-10-18); the snapshot's 7.2-1 differs in 7 of the 24, which would change the layer's recorded system-header digest. Installed over the snapshot's package with pacman -U after its sha256 is checked.

extra_packages.git: lets actions/checkout clone (the package manifest records git_head and git_dirty)
extra_packages.python-numpy: check_intel_free.py's fast window scan (the same result as its pure-Python fallback)

dxc.about: Microsoft's DirectX Shader Compiler release for Linux (bin/dxc, lib/libdxcompiler.so). CI uses it only to disassemble DXIL for check_intel_free.py's constant-array scan and for release/ci/check_controls.py; nothing CI builds is compiled with it. The reference DXC (lock toolchain.dxc and toolchain.profile) is Microsoft's v1.9.2607 release for Linux, unmodified (515,588,543 bytes; release/build_profile.py needs it to rebuild release/profile byte for byte, so CI does not run that rebuild); on 2026-10-18 this release gave identical constant arrays for all 83 DXIL files of the locked profile, and check_intel_free.py self-test (which needs the private profile) passed with it.
